almarBeachClub.intro: Case study of a landing page Artecium is building for Almar Beach Club. Work is in a local environment, not yet complete, and there is no confirmed public URL.
almarBeachClub.statusNote: This project is in development. Content, features and screenshots on Artecium reflect the current state of the work — not a published or finalized website.

context.title: Context
paragraphs: Almar Beach Club is located at Praia de Albarquel, Setúbal. The project goal is a landing page that presents the venue clearly for visitors and potential customers.
This is a real project in progress, built locally by Artecium, without claiming completion or public launch at this stage.

solution.title: Solution in development
paragraphs: Artecium is designing and building a landing page focused on the venue identity and essential information for people looking to discover the beach club.
The approach follows the visual and UX standards used in Artecium website projects: clear structure, responsive layout and room to evolve as the project progresses.

objectives.title: Landing page objectives
objectives.intro: Based on the scope defined for this project, the landing page is oriented towards:
items: Presenting the venue and atmosphere of the beach club
